license_note: Google provides Gemini 2.5 Pro as a managed service under the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service, which incorporate the Google APIs Terms of Service and a Prohibited Use Policy. The terms permit customer applications but prohibit extracting or replicating model components such as parameter weights, so nothing is licensed for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Access to Gemini 2.5 Pro through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, including the incorporated Google APIs Terms of Service and Prohibited Use Policy

access_boundary: This record represents the stable Gemini 2.5 Pro release identified by the model code gemini-2.5-pro (latest update June 2025). The retired gemini-2.5-pro-preview-* versions, Gemini 2.5 Flash, the Vertex AI and Gemini app products, and later Gemini releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents a stable model code, a latest-update date, and a stable/preview/experimental version naming scheme
Google publishes a deprecations page that lists released and retired 2.5 Pro versions with earliest shutdown dates
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The deprecations policy lists earliest possible shutdown dates rather than a fixed notice period, so continued availability depends on Google's lifecycle decisions

evidence.label: Official Gemini API deprecations and model lifecycle page
